articles.description:
Gradient Descent is one of the most widely used optimization algorithms in  machine learning and artificial intelligence. Its main purpose is to minimize the cost (or loss) function of a model. The cost function measures how far the model’s predicted output is from the actual output. In simple terms, it tells us how wrong the model is.
The ultimate goal of gradient descent is to find the best set of model parameters (such as weights and biases) that produce the lowest possible error. By repeatedly adjusting these parameters, gradient descent helps the model learn and improve its predictions over time.
Discover more
Gradient descent works by calculating the gradient of the cost function with respect to each parameter in the model. A gradient is a mathematical value that shows the direction …

articles.description:
The phrase “Rise of Bharat” represents more than economic growth—it reflects India’s transformation into a confident, self-reliant, and globally influential nation. Rooted in its civilizational values while embracing modern innovation, Bharat is redefining its role on the world stage. This rise is powered by technology, entrepreneurship, demographic strength, and a renewed focus on inclusive development.
A Strong Economic Foundation
India has emerged as one of the world’s fastest-growing major economies. Structural reforms, improved ease of doing business, and a focus on manufacturing and infrastructure have strengthened the nation’s economic base. Initiatives such as Make in India, Atmanirbhar Bharat, and large-scale infrastructure projects are driving long-term growth while creating employment opportunities across urban and rural regions.
The rise of Bharat is also visible in its expanding middle class, increasing domestic consumption, and growing investor confidence. Together, these factors position India as a key engine of global economic growth.
Digital Transformation and Innovation
Digital India has become a cornerstone of Bharat’s ascent. From UPI-based payments to widespread internet connectivity, technology has empowered millions. Digital public infrastructure has improved financial inclusion, governance transparency, and service delivery at scale.
India’s startup ecosystem is another powerful driver. With thousands of startups across fintech, healthtech, edtech, and agritech, Bharat is fostering innovation that addresses local challenges while offering global solutions. This spirit of innovation reflects a nation moving from being a consumer of technology to a creator of technology.
articles.title: Rise of Bharat: India’s Journey Toward a New Era of Growth and Global Leadership

articles.author: Sandeep
articles.description:
Welcome to Day 22 of the Spark Mastery Series.
If your Spark job is slow, unstable, or expensive, shuffle is the reason 90% of the time.
Let’s understand why.
🌟 What Exactly Is a Shuffle?
This is required for:
joins
aggregations
sorting
ranking
But it comes at a huge cost.
🌟 Why Shuffles Are Expensive
Writes intermediate data to disk
Sends data over the network
Sorts large datasets
Creates new execution stages
This makes shuffle the slowest operation in Spark.
🌟 Reading Shuffle in Explain Plan
df.explain(True)

Look for:
Exchange
SortMergeJoin
HashAggregate
These indicate shuffle boundaries.
🌟 Shuffle in Spark UI
Key metrics:
Shuffle Read (bytes)
Shuffle Write (bytes)
Spill (memory/disk)
Task skew (long tail tasks)
If you see:
One task running much longer → skew
High shuffle read/write → optimization needed
🌟 Real Example
Bad pipeline
df.join(df2, "id").groupBy("id").count()

Optimised
df2_small = broadcast(df2)
df.join(df2_small, "id").groupBy("id").count()

Result:
Shuffle reduced
Runtime improved drastically
🌟 How Senior Engineers Think
Is this shuffle necessary?
Can I broadcast?
Can I aggregate earlier?
Can I reduce data before shuffle?
🚀 Summary
What shuffle is
What causes shuffle
Why shuffle is slow
How to identify shuffle
How skew affects shuffle
How to think like a senior engineer
Follow for more such content. Let me know if I missed anything. Thank you!!
articles.title: Day 22: Spark Shuffle Deep Dive
